name: Scheduled Bell Pool
description: Kalshi's 15-minute crypto prices under-react to two scheduled volatility jumps tied to traditional markets opening: the 9:30 ET US stock market open (weekdays) and the Sunday 6 pm ET CME futures reopen. In those windows, a few minutes in, buy whichever side is currently losing (ETH and BTC); pooling both bells gives the sample size neither had alone.
hypothesis: Scheduled TradFi venue openings are vol steps (9:30 ET: +1.03 log vs month mean; Sunday 18:00 ET: +0.9) that Kalshi's trailing-vol pricing misses (implied vol ~0.25-0.3 log low), so the underdog is cheap. Losers: favourite buyers and bots using trailing vol without a clock prior. Rule is us-hours-vol v2 unchanged, plus the Sunday bell, ETH+BTC fixed in advance (SOL excluded: it prices both bells, research -0.5c and +0.7c). Mon-Thu 18:00 excluded (weak: ETH +5c se 4.5, BTC -0.7c). Wrong if the pooled full walk-forward CI isn't above 0, or <60% of months positive, or the Sunday bell pulls the pool down.
